# Global green lane and free routing

Global green-lane router and discovery, route economics and tournament, free runtime mesh, free mission clock, UberZero substitution, UberGrant.

> Navigation aid, not evidence. A listed file exists; that says nothing about whether it runs, is deployed, or has produced any external result.

**90 files** match this project by name. [All projects](README.md) · [Master index](../../REPOSITORY_INDEX.md)

Before present-tense claims, also check `docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.json` and `docs/CURRENT_SYSTEM_STATE.md`; dated documents describe their date, not today.

## Understanding

**What it is.** The lawful-route finder: a freshness-checked registry of jurisdiction and provider rules, a router through legal form, recipient type, consent and cost to the best permitted route, and a classifier of invited versus cold contact from dated evidence.

**What you use it for.** Finding the lowest-friction contact route that is actually permitted for each prospect, or stopping.
